description: This file implements commands related to 'git upload-archive', including functions to handle command-line arguments, initiate the archive process, communicate with subprocesses, and transmit data and errors. It defines two main command functions: 'cmd_upload_archive_writer' and 'cmd_upload_archive', which facilitate uploading archives within the Git version control system.

methods.name: int cmd_upload_archive_writer(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Handles the creation and sending of the archive based on client arguments, setting up the archive writer and transmitting data and errors to the client.

methods.name: void error_clnt(const char * fmt,...)
methods.description: Formats an error message and sends it to the client sideband, then terminates execution.

methods.name: ssize_t process_input(int child_fd,int band)
methods.description: Reads data from a file descriptor and sends it over the sideband to the client, reporting errors if they occur.

methods.name: int cmd_upload_archive(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Manages the process of uploading an archive by spawning a child process, monitoring its output, and relaying data and errors appropriately.
